capabilities: Open a dual-pane view of the current and next note with synchronized scrolling
Open a triple-pane view showing previous, current, and next notes
Switch between Dual Pane, Triple Pane, and Stop modes from the toolbar or hotkeys
Use the multi-column layout in Edit, Preview, and Source modes
extras: Detailed usage documentation (user guide, changelog) is linked externally rather than included in the README. Requires Obsidian v1.8.7+.
intentEvidence: Based on the original Folio plugin by adeyahya.
problem: Obsidian's default pane layout shows one note at a time per pane, so reading or editing across consecutive notes requires manually arranging and scrolling panes.

relations.evidence: Based on the original Folio plugin by adeyahya.

summary: Multi-column workspace plugin that shows two or three notes side by side with synchronized scrolling for continuous reading and editing.
